overview: A one-page list of papers for State Department file 894C.4054, concerning marriage and divorce in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records a September 2, 1939 report from Dairen, numbered 125, on the procedure American citizens were to follow when contracting marriages in the territory, with a reference to SEL 133/2909.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning marriage and divorce in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: The sheet registers a report on the procedure for American citizens contracting marriage in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: This file index identifies the subject as marriage and divorce in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It lists Dairen report no. 125, dated September 2, 1939, concerning the marriage procedure applicable to American citizens. The entry also supplies the reference SEL 133/2909, but the underlying report is not included in the surviving OCR text.

interest: The sheet is useful as evidence of U.S. consular attention to the legal formalities governing American marriages in the Japanese-administered Kwantung Leased Territory. Although the substantive report is absent, its number, date, subject, and reference code provide a precise lead for locating the original document or related consular records.
